annotations.title: List or create owners in the account

description: WHEN you need the owners (landlords) of the subscriber's SynergieLoc account — a property needs an owner_id. Lists them; with `creer` {first_name, last_name, email?, phone?, address?, postal_code?, city?, company_name?} creates one and returns its id. Writes to the account.
